hero.lead: A nation of 9.5 million with farmland across more than half its land, where the Council of the EU approved a new recovery and resilience plan of about €10 billion in July 2026.

stats.label: New EU recovery and resilience plan, July 2026

record.text: New recovery and resilience plan of about €10 billion, about €6.5 billion in grants and €3.5 billion in loans, approved by the Council of the EU on 10 July 2026

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Farmland
items.label: Of the land in agriculture, 2023
items.text: Land that can feed the nation and earn abroad, valued and financed against its harvest.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 14.4% are under fifteen: the workforce and the market of the next generation.

items.name: The Fresh Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water a person, 2022
items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.

items.name: The Clean Grid
items.label: Of electricity from renewable sources, 2021
items.text: Power from water, wind and sun already flows; every new connection can be clean.
